title: PRI adds Mexico to sovereign climate engagement programme
lede: Mexico first emerging market nation to be covered by climate engagement initiative, responding to 'significant interest' from investors.

title: Corrupt foreign officials should face EU visa-bans and asset-freezes, MEPs and Estonia say
lede: The anti-corruption bolt-on would have a moral and a strategic value, said Polish rightwing MEP and former interior minister Michał Kamiński, who co-signed the text. "The EU must not become a safe haven for kleptocrats ... that buy loyalty and political influence".
